g.text: CPU read results depend on reader, workload and storage
Synthetic smooth4 uint16, 16 GiB, sixteen 1 GiB raw shards; Blosc-Zstd, level 3, bitshuffle.
Left/right: fixed 16 KiB blocks. Middle: separate NFS spot check with block = chunk; three encodings shown.
Three repetitions per point; bars show observed min–max. Divide rates by two for useful uint16 GiB/s.
Crops: (1,256,256); complete scans: batched (8,256,256) tiles. Host output; 32 decode/copy participants, 16 readers.
